A NEW independent NetworkX full maximal-clique traversal found 1,473 compatibility edges, exactly 62,707 maximal cliques, largest clique size 10, exactly 9 labeled size-10 maxima. Intersection of maxima equals {000000,001100,110011,111111}; shadow-union cardinalities are [26,28,28,28,30,30,30,30,32]; sorted census SHA-256 082cb965d2fdf3639d1e269042c7b0beb4c6fc31317c3158df3d0ef89093582b. Explicit complement and reversal actions produce orbit sizes 1,1,1,2,2,2; only VT_0(6) has all 32 descendants and equals the sole maximum VT syndrome class. The target’s branch-and-bound Bron–Kerbosch pruning preserves all size-10 candidates but does NOT enumerate every maximal clique when pruning below the running best; its counter maximal_count must not be interpreted as total maximal cliques. This auxiliary limitation does not falsify the enumerated final theorem.

The earlier publication additionally proves a strictly richer shadow-size distribution.
